tagline: Track how AI answer engines cite your brand
one_liner: AEO Signal monitors ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot to show exactly how AI answer engines cite, describe, and rank your brand.
positioning: A proof-of-concept AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) monitoring product for early AEO partners. Sits next to SEO tools but tracks a different surface: what AI assistants say about a brand, not what Google ranks.
audience: Marketing / growth leaders at B2B SaaS companies who already invest in SEO and want visibility into AI-answer citations
Founders and marketers worried about competitors being cited instead of them in ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/Copilot answers

tone: Data-first — leads with a real number, not an adjective
Plain English, short sentences, minimal jargon (define AEO on first use)
Slightly urgent without fear-mongering — frames gaps as fixable, not scary
do: Lead headlines with a concrete finding ("Perplexity cites you most; Copilot is your biggest opportunity")
Use specific numbers and counts ("3 of 7 prompts", "+6.1 pts vs last 30 days") over vague claims
Pair every claim with a next action ("Publish a structured FAQ")
Keep CTAs short and low-friction ("Book a demo", "See a live signal report")
dont: Don't invent precision that wasn't measured (no fake "62/100" scores)
Don't bury the finding under throat-clearing — say the result in the headline

proof_points: Tracks 4 answer engines: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot
Runs thousands of real customer prompts against tracked engines daily
Weekly signal report plus real-time alerts when a competitor gains ground
key_messages: Getting cited by AI answer engines is a function of checkable things: entity clarity, structured data, and content shaped like an answer.
AEO is a different, additional surface from traditional SEO — ranking on Google doesn't guarantee being cited in an AI answer.
The gap list (prompts where you're not cited, and who is cited instead) is the most actionable output, more useful than a topline score.
